description:
Full disclosure, AMD sent over the Sapphire RX 9070 GRE for review. All other parts in this video were purchased this week on Amazon. No money changed hands, and all opinions are 100% my own.

Grab yourself a Pint Glass at https://craftcomputing.store

Pick up an LTT Screwdriver: https://bit.ly/4ojuQ6A
Or LTT Precision Driver Set: https://bit.ly/4efQhRe

The AMD Radeon RX 9070 GRE 12GB launched last week for the first time in the Western world, and reviewers were quick to strike it down as 'just another cash grab from a vengeful corporation' all while recommending you... spend more money to buy better products from that same corporation, because they're a better deal?

This hobby has always been rife with elitism, and with costs for 'mid-tier' GPUs surging to $800 with no end in sight, it's time to ask... do you really NEED to play Upgrade Hopscotch just to play games?
